product.title: “Classic Acadia” Private Tour: Cadillac Mountain & Thunder Hole

description.text: Avoid crowds and skip the stress of planning, driving, and parking while exploring Acadia National Park. Your guide covers landmark stops such as Thunder Hole, Jordan Pond, Ocean Path, or Park Loop Road depending on the itinerary. Stops include Cadillac Mountain, Thunder Hole, Park Loop Road. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
